system_type.ask: What kind of AI system is it?
system_type.settle_by: Read the system design document; confirm whether any learned model sits in the decision path.

values.predictive_ml: Predictive or classification model trained on data (scoring, ranking, anomaly detection)
values.rules_based: Rules or deterministic logic with no learned model (listed so the tool can say learned-model items do not apply)
values.genai_llm: Generative model or LLM based application (text, summarisation, chat, retrieval augmented)
values.agentic: Agent that plans and calls tools or takes actions
values.computer_vision: Image, video or document vision model

audience.ask: Who uses the system or its outputs?
audience.settle_by: Confirm from the service description who receives outputs and who is affected by them.

values.public_facing: Members of the public or businesses interact with it, or are directly affected by its outputs

data_types.ask: Which kinds of data does it process? List all that apply, or use none.
data_types.settle_by: Have the data owner or data protection officer inventory the fields in real (not synthetic) inputs and outputs.

decision_impact.settle_by: Have the business owner state what the output is used for and whether a person reviews it before any effect on a trader, traveller or citizen.

values.none: No effect on any person's rights, services, duties or entitlements
values.advisory: Advisory only; a person decides and the output is one input among others
values.significant_support: Decision support where the output is a principal basis for a decision with a significant effect
values.automated_significant: The system makes or triggers a decision with a significant effect without a person's review
values.critical: Decisions affecting life, liberty or safety

hosting.settle_by: Ask the infrastructure owner. No retrieved source sets a location keyed requirement, so this does not change the checklist today.

values.foreign_cloud: Cloud or service outside the UAE

acquisition.settle_by: Check contracts and the bill of materials for vendor models or services.

values.vendor_product: Bought or licensed from a vendor
values.mixed: Vendor model with in house integration

entity_zone.ask: Which regime is the deploying entity in?
entity_zone.settle_by: Ask the deploying authority legal and governance office which instrument family applies to it (federal, emirate level, free zone, sector regulator) and obtain legal review.

values.abu_dhabi_gov: Abu Dhabi government entity (not health sector)
values.health_abu_dhabi: Healthcare entity licensed by Abu Dhabi Department of Health
values.health_dubai: Healthcare entity regulated by Dubai Health Authority

eu_market.ask: Is the system placed on the EU market, or is its output used in the EU?
eu_market.settle_by: Confirm with the business owner whether any output is used in the EU.
